## Power BI data contract review

### Contract

- Product ID:
- Contract version:
- Power BI report:
- Power BI semantic model:
- Owner:
- Steward:

### Validation

- [ ] Local contract validator passes.
- [ ] Exact DAX is present for every metric.
- [ ] Grain and aggregation rules are documented.
- [ ] Source lineage is matched or exceptioned.
- [ ] Report visual usage is reconciled or exceptioned.
- [ ] Relationships and join assumptions are documented.
- [ ] Glossary terms are mapped or identified as pending.
- [ ] No secrets or raw production data are included.

### Impact

- [ ] Downstream report impact reviewed.
- [ ] Agent/API impact reviewed.
- [ ] Version change type is documented.
- [ ] Known limitations are recorded.

### Approval

- [ ] Power BI peer review complete.
- [ ] Steward review complete.
- [ ] Publication request is separately authorized.
